What it solves: - [2026-08-28] specifier: minted in answer to the cleaner's question. The

  because the constitution's guardrail tells a role finding dirty
  `swarmforge/scripts` paths to restore and log a recurrence WITHOUT

It is new: BL-373's fix is deployed and correct in isolation, but its guard fails OPEN under an ambient git environment, which is the live condition on this host. Confi…
BL-1233 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1233" (or "reject BL-1233 <reason>") to act.
